primary_target.name: Next-step same-layer routing prediction
primary_target.definition: For decode step t and each MoE layer l, predict the set of expert IDs E_{t,l} that will be routed/requested at step t in layer l. k_tl = |E_{t,l}| is the router's requested cardinality for that (step,layer) as recorded in trace metadata (trace.meta.top_k / per-event routing count). For the canonical Qwen3-30B-A3B Research2 trace contract this is expected to be 8; implementations must read actual k_tl from trace metadata/events and not assume 8 when trace evidence differs. Input may use only information available at the frozen causal decision boundary before observing E_{t,l}, forbidden same-step layers, and future steps.

secondary_targets.name: Short-horizon future working-set prediction
secondary_targets.definition: For each layer l at decision time t, predict the union U_{t,l,h}=Union_{i=1..h} E_{t+i,l} for preregistered horizon h. Used only as secondary/diagnostic unless explicitly promoted by a future contract version (not in R2-09B).
secondary_targets.horizon_justification: Grounded in published R2-07 DEV characterization: immediate reuse strong, reuse <=4 strong, reuse <=16 much weaker relative to shuffled null. Horizons frozen here; not selected/changed after EVAL.

input_time_semantics.definition: When predicting E_{t,l} (routing for layer l at decode step/token t), the predictor may use only causal information available before observing the target and forbidden elements.
allowed: all completed prior decode steps t_prime < t (routing, cache state, recency/frequency/transition history, and other preregistered causal features)
intrastep cross-layer causal context: routing outcomes and causal features from layers < l of the same step t MAY be used because they have already occurred causally in the forward pass
forbidden: any layer > l of the same step t
EVAL labels or post-hoc unavailable labels
input_time_semantics.stricter_variant: A prior-step-only (no same-step earlier-layer) variant may be reported only as secondary/diagnostic if separately preregistered; primary benchmark permits intrastep cross-layer causal context.

allowed_feature_families.note: Candidate signal; may include prior-step cross-layer history and/or intrastep layers < l of same step t under the frozen causal boundary. Not established superior.
Allowed only if observable before retention decisions and explicitly preregistered/frozen before DEV tuning; not post-hoc runtime-unavailable label.

examples: post-hoc workload labels unavailable at runtime

primary_metric_cutoff.k_definition: k_tl = router requested cardinality for target (t,l) from trace metadata/event (expected 8 for canonical Qwen3-30B-A3B Research2 traces).
primary_metric_cutoff.predictor_output_cardinality: Primary set prediction must output exactly k_tl unique expert IDs for target (t,l). A ranked/scored predictor is evaluated at cutoff k_tl.
primary_metric_cutoff.tie_breaking: deterministic: higher score first; ties broken by lower stable (layer, expert_id) lexical/numeric key (expert_id ascending within layer) unless trace uses a different stable global key, which must be recorded; never hash-map order.
primary_metric_cutoff.variable_cardinality: Not expected for canonical top-k routing; if encountered, use actual |E_{t,l}| as k_tl for that target and require exactly |E_{t,l}| predicted unique experts.
primary_metric_cutoff.anti_gaming: Recall is computed at fixed cardinality k_tl; predicting more than k_tl experts is not permitted for the primary set metric (extra predictions ignored only if a reporting bug occurs and must be flagged; implementations must enforce exactly k_tl).
